result.title: VeilGS: Solving Darkness as a Veil of 2D Basis Maps over Retinex 3DGS
result.summary: In a dark capture, the darkness is not uniform. How much light reaches a surface depends on where it lies relative to the few light sources, and the camera compresses what remains with a tone curve. Most low-light 3D reconstruction methods either apply one curve to every pixel of a view, so a dark object beside a lamp and a bright one in an unlit corner receive the same correction, or store the darkness in the 3D representation, where it can absorb scene detail. We present VeilGS, a 3D Gaussian Splatting method for low-light novel view synthesis that treats the degradation as a veil drawn over a clear scene. Each Gaussian carries an albedo and a shading latent instead of spherical harmonics, separating surface colour from illumination. Each view is darkened by a spatially varying gain followed by a global tone curve, and rendering without this veil gives the restored scene. A small network predicts a coarse basis for the gain from the observation, and its coefficients are solved for each view rather than learned. Training through this solve discourages the Gaussians from absorbing what the veil can explain. VeilGS needs no paired normal-light supervision and stores no per-view parameters. On Gaussian-DK, its restored renders score best on no-reference NIQE and CLIP-IQA and are rated highest in a blind user study with 55 participants. On LOM, it achieves results competitive with the state of the art.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VeilGS，一种低光照新视角合成的 3D Gaussian Splatting 方法：把暗化视为覆盖在清晰场景上的「veil」，每个 Gaussian 用 albedo 与 shading latent 取代球谐以分离表面颜色与光照，并由小网络预测空间变化增益的粗 basis、逐视图求解系数而非学习，渲染时去掉 veil 即得恢复场景。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预测 basis、逐输入求解系数并让梯度穿过求解」的机制旨在防止表示吸收可由外部模型解释的成分，可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节被 nuisance 吸收与 latent 信息坍缩的正则化思路；论文本身面向 3D 重建，与视觉推理无直接关系。
